apps.name: apple-health-connector
apps.title: Apple Health Connector
apps.description: Ports over, collects, and analyzes data from Apple Health
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged into the dashboard with zero clicks; the machine ingest endpoint is public and gated by a self-issued API key, as expected for device uploads.

apps.name: backup
apps.title: Backup
apps.description: Back up all Cloud in a Bottle data to any Restic provider

apps.name: bifrost
apps.title: Bifrost
apps.description: Runs the Bifrost LLM gateway and exposes an OpenAI-compatible API as a cross-app service
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner reaches the web UI via Cloud in a Bottle perimeter gating (no login form); its OpenAI-compatible inference API is exposed to other apps behind a full_access grant — perimeter-based, not a full owner session.

apps.name: bluesky
apps.title: Bluesky
apps.description: Your own Bluesky account on your own server: an AT Protocol PDS plus the official web client on one domain, federating with the wider network.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner lands signed in with zero clicks via a real server-minted PDS session while federation paths stay anonymously reachable, but the SSO app-password and PDS identity secrets are persisted as 0600 files rather than injected directly.

apps.name: calibre-web
apps.title: Calibre-Web
apps.description: Self-hosted web app for browsing, reading, and downloading your ebook library, with an OPDS feed, Kobo sync, and per-user access — a clean web front end for a Calibre library.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in as admin via the owner header, but invited readers still sign in with Calibre-Web-local password accounts.

apps.name: cap
apps.title: Cap
apps.description: Open-source Loom alternative — record your screen in the browser and share links, fully self-hosted.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-logged into a seeded Cap account with zero clicks via trusted-proxy SSO (no email code); share links play for accountless guests, and video blobs stay on the instance.

apps.name: code-completion
apps.title: Code Completion
apps.description: Code completion server with model management UI and OpenAI-compatible API.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner reaches the management UI via router gating (no login form) and the OpenAI-compatible API is gated by an app-issued token; access is perimeter-based rather than a full owner session.

apps.name: community-chat
apps.title: Community Chat
apps.description: Matrix Synapse homeserver with a bundled Cinny web client. End-to-end encrypted messaging, owner single sign-on, and a one-click join of the Cloud in a Bottle community space.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: The owner is auto-logged-in via SSO into the bundled web client (no login form), data persists, and the app self-restarts to apply settings. Short of 5 because it is single-owner: others who join get Synapse-local accounts, not Cloud in a Bottle SSO.

apps.name: filestash
apps.title: Filestash
apps.description: A powerful web-based file management system, compatible with SFTP, S3, and Google Drive
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-logged into the file manager with zero clicks via passthrough auth; public share links aren't exposed, so they require owner login too.

apps.name: forgejo
apps.title: Forgejo
apps.description: Self-hosted, lightweight software forge with Git hosting, issues, pull requests, CI/CD, and a package registry — a Free Software alternative to GitHub.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in as admin; invited users still create Forgejo-local password accounts.

apps.name: graphhopper
apps.title: GraphHopper
apps.description: Self-hosted routing engine built on OpenStreetMap data, with car, bike, and foot navigation profiles and a web map UI offering turn-by-turn directions.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Stateless routing engine behind Cloud in a Bottle zone auth with a small owner-only region admin; no accounts and nothing to leak, but no full owner session.

apps.name: imbue-catalyst
apps.title: Imbue Catalyst
apps.description: A tool for semi-autonomous scientific research and discovery.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Agents need to be authenticated through a separate page, and their authentications do not persist across restarts.

apps.name: jellyfin
apps.title: Jellyfin
apps.description: Free software media server for streaming your own movies, TV, music, and photos to any device.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-signed into the web UI with zero clicks via a token shim, but invited users and third-party Jellyfin client apps still sign in with app-local accounts.

apps.name: jitsi
apps.title: Jitsi Meet
apps.description: Scalable video conferencing with an SFU (Jitsi Videobridge) — anyone with the URL can join a meeting.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Anyone with the meeting URL can join by design; no per-user Cloud in a Bottle login, which fits the conferencing model.

apps.name: lila
apps.title: Lichess
apps.description: Self-hosted Lichess (Lila) chess server with one-click SSO: play, do puzzles, run tournaments, and analyze games. Pre-seeded so the lobby and leaderboards aren't empty.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in as admin with zero clicks; shared challenge/game links work for anonymous guests without a Cloud in a Bottle account, and AI/bot games play. Short of 5 because extra registered players still need Lila-local accounts.

apps.name: limesurvey
apps.title: LimeSurvey
apps.description: Self-hosted survey and questionnaire platform with a bundled database, for building and running online surveys.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-signed into the admin panel via the zone-owner header and anonymous respondents reach public surveys without a login, but any extra admin users you add use app-local passwords.

apps.name: lyftr
apps.title: Lyftr
apps.description: Self-hosted workout tracker: log lifts and sets, build programs, and track bodyweight and personal records over time.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in with zero clicks; guests hit the app's login. Single-user tracker with no accounts to bootstrap and nothing left on disk.

apps.name: md-notes
apps.title: MD Notes
apps.description: Obsidian-like collaborative markdown notes editor
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-logged-in via the trusted owner header (non-owners hit the zone login); per-note share links serve accountless guests, and whole vaults can be shared with other Cloud in a Bottle users' instances.

apps.name: minecraft
apps.title: Minecraft
apps.description: A self-hosted minecraft server runner
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Server provisions and persists worlds natively; players authenticate via Minecraft accounts, as expected for a game server.

apps.name: miniflux
apps.title: Miniflux
apps.description: Minimalist, opinionated RSS/Atom feed reader focused on readability and privacy, with keyboard-driven navigation and automatic tracker removal.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in via Cloud in a Bottle SSO; bundled Postgres persists feeds cleanly.

apps.name: mirotalk-p2p
apps.title: MiroTalk P2P
apps.description: Open-source WebRTC video conferencing where browsers connect peer-to-peer for real-time audio and video; the server only handles signaling, never media. Includes screen sharing, chat, a collaborative whiteboard, and file sharing.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in as host; guests join via the room URL. Signaling-only, no media stored.

apps.name: navidrome
apps.title: Navidrome
apps.description: Modern music server and streamer compatible with Subsonic/Airsonic clients.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-logged in as admin, but invited users and Subsonic client apps still need app-local Navidrome accounts.

apps.name: nextcloud
apps.title: Nextcloud
apps.description: Self-hosted files, calendar, and contacts platform with sync clients, sharing, and a large app ecosystem.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged into an admin account with zero clicks via the trusted owner header bridged to user_saml; sync clients (WebDAV) and public share links pass through without owner login, and non-owner visitors are never signed in as the owner.

apps.name: openchamber
apps.title: OpenChamber
apps.description: Web workspace for running and supervising AI coding agents, with session goals, diff review, GitHub workflows, and a built-in terminal.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner reaches the workspace with zero clicks via router gating and the Anthropic key comes from the secrets service; access is perimeter-based rather than an in-app owner session, and there is deliberately no guest mode.

apps.name: openclaw
apps.title: OpenClaw
apps.description: Open-source personal AI assistant you run on your own devices, reachable from chat apps you already use (WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, Discord, Signal, and more) and extendable with skills and tools.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in with full operator access via the Cloud in a Bottle owner header; a single-user assistant, so non-owners are simply rejected and no secrets are written to disk.

apps.name: openweb-ui
apps.title: Open WebUI
apps.description: Self-hosted ChatGPT-style interface for local and remote LLMs (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, etc).
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner lands as admin (Open WebUI's own auth disabled, router-gated) and guests are bounced to the zone login; owner access is perimeter-based rather than a native SSO session.

apps.name: oura-connector
apps.title: Oura Connector
apps.description: Imports, stores, and displays personal health data from Oura smart rings — including sleep, activity, and readiness metrics — and exposes the collected data through an API for other apps.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-recognized and reaches the dashboard and data with zero clicks (no app login); non-owners are bounced to the zone login. Perimeter-based rather than a full owner session.

apps.name: overleaf
apps.title: Overleaf
apps.description: Overleaf Community Edition: a self-hosted, collaborative online LaTeX editor with real-time editing and in-browser PDF compilation, with a bundled database.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-signed into the Overleaf admin with zero clicks via the owner header, and project links can be shared publicly with collaborators who have no Cloud in a Bottle account, but any named Overleaf accounts you add use app-local passwords created via the admin panel.

apps.name: pihole
apps.title: Pi-hole
apps.description: Network-wide ad blocker that blocks ads and trackers at the DNS level for every device on your network, with a web dashboard for statistics, query logs, and allow/deny list management.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Zone owner is auto-logged in to the admin dashboard, but the generated admin password is stored in plaintext on disk where other apps could read it.

apps.name: redlib
apps.title: Redlib
apps.description: Private front-end for Reddit. Browse posts and comments without JavaScript, ads, tracking, or a Reddit account; all requests are proxied through the server.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Stateless public Reddit front-end with no accounts and nothing to leak; there is nothing to integrate, and it works cleanly for everyone out of the box.

apps.name: sculptor
apps.title: Sculptor
apps.description: Build product with grounded, parallel coding agents.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Requires re-signing in rather than importing secrets

apps.name: searxng
apps.title: SearXNG
apps.description: Privacy-respecting metasearch engine that aggregates results from 70+ search services.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Stateless public metasearch with no accounts and nothing to leak; there is nothing to integrate, and it works cleanly for everyone out of the box.

apps.name: spliit
apps.title: Spliit
apps.description: Minimalist, account-free app for splitting shared expenses with friends and family.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: The owner reaches the app through zone auth and can share group links with guests who need no Cloud in a Bottle account, but Spliit has no user accounts so there is no real owner SSO to speak of.

apps.name: tangled
apps.title: Tangled Knot
apps.description: Self-hosted Tangled knot: the git data server for Tangled (tangled.org), the AT-Protocol-based social coding platform. Host your own repositories and federate with the Tangled network — your identity is your ATProto/Bluesky DID, the AppView provides the web UI and issues/PRs as ATProto records, and your knot holds the actual git data. Clone over HTTPS, push over SSH.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Deploys and persists git data cleanly, with an owner-gated in-app form to set your ATProto DID (no Cloud in a Bottle SSO — the knot has no browser login). Setup needs external steps: a Bluesky/ATProto account and a verify click on tangled.org to federate.

apps.name: uptime-kuma
apps.title: Uptime Kuma
apps.description: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with HTTP, TCP, DNS, and ping checks plus status pages.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Owner is auto-logged into the dashboard with zero clicks and guests are bounced to the zone login, but public status pages aren't exposed for anonymous viewing.

apps.name: vaultwarden
apps.title: VaultWarden
apps.description: An alternative, open-source password manager server written in Rust that implements the Bitwarden API and works with the official Bitwarden client apps.
apps.openhost_integration_score_explanation: Runs and persists data correctly, but there is no Cloud in a Bottle SSO; the owner signs in through Vaultwarden's own email and master-password login form.
